# HDR+ engine fixtures

These three unmodified DNG frames are from burst `0006_20160722_115157_431` in the [HDR+ curated dataset](https://hdrplusdata.org/dataset.html), published by Samuel W. Hasinoff, Dillon Sharlet, Ryan Geiss, Andrew Adams, Jonathan T. Barron, Florian Kainz, Jiawen Chen, and Marc Levoy.

License: [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). The original files and any derived test imagery retain this license. No changes have been made to the checked-in DNGs. Use is for engine research and verification; it does not imply endorsement by the authors.

Source prefix: `https://storage.googleapis.com/hdrplusdata/20171106_subset/bursts/0006_20160722_115157_431/`.

Citation: Hasinoff et al., _Burst photography for high dynamic range and low-light imaging on mobile cameras_, ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH Asia), 35(6), 2016. [Paper](https://www.hdrplusdata.org/hdrplus.pdf).

These mobile-camera inputs exercise the registration/accumulation engine. They are not supported-camera RAW acceptance evidence. Production camera eligibility remains Sony ZV-1/ZV-1A; tests never import these DNGs into a user library. Independently transformed, exposure-scaled, clipped, noisy or moving variants generated during tests are adaptations under the same license.
